title.zh: Linus 品牌与宠物 · 个人索引

description.zh: AChengLinus 的 DeepSeek Harness 插件索引：把 Linus 插画装进侧栏品牌位与输入框上沿的宠物。
description.en: AChengLinus' DeepSeek Harness plugin index: the Linus artwork as the sidebar brand mark and as the composer pet.

description.zh: 把 Linus 插画装进 DeepSeek Harness Web：侧栏品牌位换成角色头像 + 名字，输入框上沿的默认吉祥物（Deepy 鲸鱼）换成同一角色的 18 状态手绘动画（24–72 帧、≈19 fps、像素粒子、状态切换淡入）。不修改皮肤文件，卸载即复原。需要皮肤 dsh-claude-style 且吉祥物设为 Deepy。
description.en: Paints the Linus artwork into the DeepSeek Harness web UI: the sidebar brand mark becomes the character avatar plus name, and the composer pet becomes the same character in 18 hand-drawn animation states (24-72 distinct frames, ~19 fps, pixel particles, soft fade on state change). Skin files stay untouched; uninstalling restores the stock look. Requires dsh-claude-style with mascot: deepy.
